description: Restored in 2024 and displayed near the entrance to the former BAN Nimes-Garons. Since 2026 it shares a fenced enclosure with the Alize and both are visible from the D42. Listed by ARDHAN (Claude Morin) August 2025 and by foxalphazoulou.overblog.com 2026.
museum_name: Conservatoire Historique de l'Aéronautique Navale, Nîmes-Garons

description: Held by the Conservatoire Historique de l'Aeronautique Navale for 13 years on a stele inside the former base; moved in 2026 into the enclosure with the Atlantic, where both are visible from the D42. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
museum_name: Conservatoire Historique de l'Aéronautique Navale, Nîmes-Garons
